# Hongyu Li — Robotics Researcher
> Third-year PhD candidate in Computer Science at Brown University, advised by Prof. George Konidaris. Research focuses on robot manipulation, tactile sensing, and visuotactile perception.

## Key Pages
- [About](https://lhy.xyz/): Academic bio, research interests, and contact information
- [Publications](https://lhy.xyz/publications/): Full list of 16+ publications at ICRA, IROS, RSS, RA-L
- [CV](https://lhy.xyz/cv/): Curriculum vitae with education and experience

## Research Areas
- Robot manipulation and grasping
- Tactile and visuotactile sensing
- Pose estimation and object perception
- Deep learning for robotics
- World models and reinforcement learning

## Key Publications
- [VITA-Zero](https://lhy.xyz/projects/VITA-Zero/): Visuotactile pose estimation (ICRA 2026)
- [V-HOP](https://lhy.xyz/projects/V-HOP/): Vision-based hand-object pose estimation
- [StereoVoxelNet](https://lhy.xyz/projects/StereoVoxelNet/): Real-time obstacle detection
